notes: Main disagreements: (1) document stance: the AI FAQ was delegates (A) vs restrict (B); resolved to delegates because the FAQ only says how to label a violation when AI is not authorized for an assignment and never sets a default. (2) policy_type: library sample statements, where a rule has a permit/prohibit act and a documentation condition (general-writing permission P24 vs P02, open-book exam P24 vs P02, documentation P26 vs P24, 'AI generated submissions cannot achieve a passing grade' P19 vs P35, surpass-AI rationale P94 vs P41, amend-the-samples P110 vs P04); resolved by the main act of the sentence and what a reader looking for that rule would expect, with fit notes kept. CSE: syllabus suggestion P110 vs P09, deviations from department rule P09 vs P04, no-response fallback in the FAQ P81 vs P57, FERPA non-disclosure UNCOVERED vs P81 (kept UNCOVERED). (3) phase: classification sentences (when-misuse vs general), syllabus-expectation sentences (course-start vs before-course), 'rules may change' (over-time vs course-start), instructor course design (before-course vs during-work). (4) modality: classification sentences ('Academic misconduct is present ...') resolved as informs, TA expulsion consequences as informs. (5) actor: 'student has the due process right' (student), department's promise of more guidance (admin), FERPA limit on the office (admin). (6) unit_stance: sample statements with documentation or responsibility (neutral/require, not permit). (7) granularity: B merged the two halves of the misconduct sentence and the appeal routing with the chair advice; A split them, and A's splits were kept. A merged attribution with editing for accuracy; the reconciler split them into two units (one extra unit not counted in only_A). A-only units (9) are real statements (nondisclosure violation, appeal ruling, teacher choice, three principles, rationale for documentation, writing attestation, reliable-evidence standard, trust-and-honesty rationale). B-only units (6) are real (integrity training module, decision-tree pointer, facts must be true, code attestation, 'Doing so will result in a cheating violation', TA expulsion). All kept. Free-form topic codes from B were replaced by codebook codes. new_types empty on both sides.
